name: Count Off
summary: Ilse Varga's mercenary company marched into the mists a year ago at the invitation of someone who signed himself S. She was meant to march with them.

stages.journal: A year ago Kestrel Company, the forty mercenaries Ilse marched with for eleven years, took a contract that sent them down a fog-bound road. Ilse was meant to ride with them. When she followed, the road ended in mist and the company was gone: no bodies, no blood, no tracks. All she has is the invitation the captain left in his tent, sealed and signed with a single ornate S.
objectives: Learn what became of Kestrel Company

stages.journal: The S is Strahd von Zarovich, the lord of this valley. He wrote to Kestrel Company and invited them in as his guests. Nobody in Barovia has seen them since, which in Barovia is not the same as nobody knowing.
objectives: Find the road Kestrel Company took

stages.journal: On the march, the corporal on watch carves the company's tally each night: a kestrel, and a stroke for every soldier present. Ilse found the first one in Barovia on a milestone at the crossroads. Forty strokes, in Corporal Vell's hand: 'Night 1. All present. Guides say the castle is two days.'
objectives: Look for the company's next night's tally

stages.journal: The second tally is cut into a tree at Tser Pool, where Vistani guides camped the company: thirty-one strokes. 'Night 2. Nine gone in the night. Guides say wolves. There were no wolves.' Under it, in another hand, a single line: 'J.F. I'm sorry.'
objectives: Find out who J.F. was, and where he went

stages.journal: J.F. is Jory Fenn, the company's youngest, who ran from the castle gate on the third night and has stood watch on Vallaki's wall ever since under another name. He saw the captain go in to sign the contract, and come out on the battlements that night, calling the company in to dinner one name at a time.
objectives: Find the rest of Kestrel Company

stages.journal: Madam Eva said Ilse would see one of her forty before the end, walking the devil's roads in colours not his own. On the castle road at night, she did: Corporal Teodor Vell, who carved the tallies, in Strahd's crimson and hungry.
Corporal Vell is at rest. Ilse counted him off, the way the company counts the dead on the march: one name, one number, and then the next. 'One,' she said. The rest are somewhere in the castle.
objectives: Find the rest of Kestrel Company in Castle Ravenloft

stages.journal: Kestrel Company is counted off. Every name Ilse could find has a number now, and the captain who signed for them answered for it. She stood in the castle and called the roll to the end, and for the first time in a year, nobody was missing.
